$comment: Shared by src-tauri/src/attachments.rs and src/lib/attachments.ts (spec: SPECs/image-insertion-spec.md). importExtensions are the image types dropped or pasted into a note and saved to the attachment folder; renderExtensions are the ones the webview can show inline as ![[name.ext]] (heic is kept as-is but does not render). mimeExtensions maps an image Content-Type to the extension it is saved under (clipboard and drag types in the webview, download responses in Rust).
